On 16 July 2026, Appellant submitted a motion to withdraw Appellant’s
case from appellate review, accompanied by a request to attach Appellant’s DD
Form 2330, Waiver/Withdrawal of Appellate Rights in General and Special
Courts-Martial Subject to Review by a Court of Criminal Appeals, signed by
Appellant on 29 June 2026 and Appellant’s counsel on 16 July 2026.
Accordingly, it is by the court on this 22d day of July, 2026,
ORDERED:
Appellant’s Motion to Withdraw from Appellate Review and Attach is
GRANTED. Appellant’s case is forwarded to the Appellate Records Branch
(JAJM) for further processing in accordance with Rules for Courts-Martial
1115(f)(3) and 1201, Manual for Courts-Martial, United States (2024 ed.).
FOR THE COURT
JACOB B. HOEFERKAMP, Capt, USAF
Chief Commissioner
